BLM looks to hire 130 staff in Oregon to accommodate increase in timber sales

status_summary: On 2026-02-19 BLM published a notice of intent to revise two resource management plans covering about 2.46 million acres, mostly O&C lands, aiming to raise sustained-yield timber harvest toward historically higher levels and set a new allowable sale quantity; scoping comments closed 2026-03-23, and the notice reserves roughly a quarter of the area from harvest. Reporting on 2026-07-16 said BLM Oregon timber sales exceeded 241 million board feet in fiscal 2025, up more than 15 percent. No draft plan and no change to the Cascade-Siskiyou monument was found.

timeline.event: BLM published a notice of intent to revise the Northwestern and Coastal Oregon and Southwestern Oregon resource management plans to increase sustained-yield timber harvest toward historically higher levels.
Reporting said BLM timber sales in Oregon topped 241 million board feet in fiscal 2025, up more than 15 percent, and that BLM planned to hire 130 staff to support more sales.

title: Manage Oregon and California railroad lands for higher sustained-yield timber
uncertainties: A Federal Register API search after 2026-02-20 found no draft plan. The sales volume figures come from one news report, not BLM data. A search for Cascade-Siskiyou monument changes found only 2017 coverage. The earlier repost of public radio coverage was not opened and was removed.
